input.oldString:
De-Googling Tips
1. Start with Search Change your default search engine to DuckDuckGo in your browser settings. This is one of the easiest first steps.
2. Use Privacy-Focused Browsers Switch to Firefox or Brave, which have built-in tracking protection and don't send data to Google.
3. Replace Google Services Gradually Don't try to replace everything at once. Start with one service, like switching from Gmail to ProtonMail, and build from there.
4. Use Open-Source Software Whenever possible, choose open-source alternatives that you can audit and that respect your privacy.
5. Take Control of Your Data Download your Google data before leaving and consider self-hosting services like Nextcloud for personal cloud storage.
